name: Clio Infotech Limited
about: Clio Infotech Limited, an information technology (IT) company, engages in the provision of software solutions and IT services for the insurance, capital market, and asset and wealth management industries in India. It also offers software and IT solutions for the manufacturing, retail, distribution, telecom, and healthcare sectors. The company was formerly known as Clio Finance Limited and changed its name to Clio Infotech Limited in December 1999. Clio Infotech Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
